title: Guides in global search, purpose on library tiles
lede: ⌘K and /search now return matching guides, Resources no longer steals the shortcut, and library tiles show a one-line purpose from the existing summary.

sections.heading: Resources library
sections.note: After-only authenticated Preview, ADMIN, 1440×900, light appearance. A matched before for this slice was not captured; the previous landing proofs show cards/list without purpose lines but at a different viewport.

shots.title: Cards with purpose
shots.cap: Featured Photo Mechanic lead and type-grouped tiles each show one truncated purpose line. Quick find is a labeled button with no ⌘K. The top-bar search copy includes guides.

shots.title: List with purpose
shots.cap: List rows keep title plus a single ellipsized purpose line. Featured lead stays. URL is ?layout=list.

shots.title: ⌘K includes Guides
shots.cap: On /resources, ⌘K opens the app-wide palette. Searching photo returns a Guides group with type and purpose, plus page hits like Software.

shots.title: /search includes Guides
shots.cap: /search?q=photo lists Guides (2) with How-to/General purpose lines, then Items.

changes.was: ⌘K and /search only hit pages, items, bookings, and users. Resources captured ⌘K for a local palette.
changes.now: Both search surfaces fan out to GET /api/resources?q=. Hits open /resources/[slug]. Resources Quick find stays an in-page button.

changes.h: Tiles say what the guide is for
changes.was: Featured, cards, and list were title-first with type marks and no purpose.
changes.now: Each surface shows the existing one-line summary. Author, date, and audience stay off the tiles.

verification: Authenticated local Preview, ADMIN, Chromium 1440×900. Login via Playwright auth setup; no production mutation.
Resources cards: 5 purpose lines. List: 4 purpose lines. Quick find kbd count 0.
⌘K on /resources opened the app-wide palette. Query photo showed Guides group and Photo Mechanic + Lightroom Ingest Guide with How-to purpose.
/search?q=photo showed Guides (2) plus page and item hits. Console errors: none.

Focused tests: tests/guide-search-result.test.ts, tests/app-shell-search-source.test.ts, tests/search-page-source.test.ts, tests/resources-ui-polish-source.test.ts, tests/resources-ui-ownership-contract.test.ts, tests/web-sidebar-source.test.ts.
npx tsc --noEmit and eslint on the touched files passed.
npm run build:app was not run because Preview already occupies :3000.
notes: After-only evidence. No hash-bound before/after pair: this slice started on an already dirty landing.
Native iOS Search and Guides list are unchanged. iOS rows stay title-first without summary.
Next.js HMR overlay is visible in captures and is not product chrome.
